Delivering on our Promises – New Policy to Close the Tax Gap
Delivering on our Promises – Collecting Tax That is Due

measures.name: Rebuilding Britain: Additional capital investment

measures.name: Compensation Payments: Making payments to victims of the infected blood scandal

measures.head: spend

measures.name: Compensation Payments: Making payments to victims of the Horizon IT scandal
measures.group: Fixing the Foundations and Rebuilding Britain
measures.head: spend

measures.name: National Wealth Fund: Mobilise investment in the UK’s clean energy and growth industries and support the delivery of our new Industrial Strategy (forecast income from investment)
measures.group: Fixing the Foundations and Rebuilding Britain
measures.head: spend

measures.name: Extraordinary Revenue Acceleration: Contribution to Extraordinary Revenue Acceleration to support military effort in Ukraine
measures.group: Fixing the Foundations and Rebuilding Britain
measures.head: spend

measures.name: Extraordinary Revenue Acceleration: Forecast repayment from extraordinary profits on sanctioned Russian sovereign assets
measures.group: Fixing the Foundations and Rebuilding Britain
measures.head: spend

measures.name: Tackling tax non-compliance in umbrella companies by moving PAYE obligations to recruitment agencies or, where an agency is not present, end client businesses from April 2026
measures.group: Delivering on our Promises – New Policy to Close the Tax Gap
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Increasing the interest rate on unpaid tax from April 2025
measures.group: Delivering on our Promises – New Policy to Close the Tax Gap
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Changes to tax rules on liquidations of Limited Liability Partnerships from 30 October 2024
measures.group: Delivering on our Promises – New Policy to Close the Tax Gap
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Strengthen existing charity tax rules from April 2026, to prevent abuse and ensure that only the intended tax relief is given to charities
measures.group: Delivering on our Promises – New Policy to Close the Tax Gap
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Preventing non-compliance from the transfer overseas of UK tax-relieved pension funds
measures.group: Delivering on our Promises – New Policy to Close the Tax Gap
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Amending anti-avoidance rules to ensure shareholders cannot extract funds untaxed from close companies from 30 October 2024
measures.group: Delivering on our Promises – New Policy to Close the Tax Gap
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Confirming plans to mandate the reporting of benefits in kind via payroll software from April 2026
measures.group: Delivering on our Promises – New Policy to Close the Tax Gap
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Ending contrived car ownership schemes: closing loopholes in employee car ownership schemes to prevent them from being used to circumvent Company Car Tax from 6 April 2026
measures.group: Delivering on our Promises – New Policy to Close the Tax Gap
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Modernising and mandating registration of tax practitioners interacting with HMRC from April 2026
measures.group: Delivering on our Promises – New Policy to Close the Tax Gap
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Increased collection of tax due supported by investment in 5,000 additional HMRC compliance staff
measures.group: Delivering on our Promises – Collecting Tax That is Due
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Increased collection of overdue tax debt by additional investment in HMRC debt management staff
measures.group: Delivering on our Promises – Collecting Tax That is Due
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Increasing tax receipts from modernising HMRC systems and data
measures.group: Delivering on our Promises – Collecting Tax That is Due
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Abolition of non-domicile status and introduction of a residence-based regime: remove the 50% discount on foreign income in 2025-26; apply inheritance tax; set Capital Gains Tax rebasing date at 5 April 2017; and extend the Temporary Repatriation Facility from two to three years
measures.group: Delivering on our Promises – Other Manifesto Tax Commitments
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Carried interest: Increase the rates of Capital Gains Tax on carried interest to 32% from 6 April 2025, then move the carried interest taxation regime to the Income Tax framework from 6 April 2026 onwards
measures.group: Delivering on our Promises – Other Manifesto Tax Commitments
measures.head: tax

measures.name: VAT: Applying the standard rate (20%) to education and boarding services provided by private schools from 1 January 2025
measures.group: Delivering on our Promises – Other Manifesto Tax Commitments
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Business Rates: Remove eligibility of private schools for charitable rate relief from 1 April 2025
measures.group: Delivering on our Promises – Other Manifesto Tax Commitments
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Energy Profits Levy (EPL): Increase the rate to 38%; abolish the EPL investment allowance except for decarbonisation expenditure and cut rate of decarbonisation allowance to 66% from 1 November 2024; sunset date extension from 31 March 2029 to 31 March 2030 as well as the introduction of tax relief for payments made into a Decommissioning Fund in relation to oil and gas assets transferred for use in Carbon Capture Usage and Storage
measures.group: Delivering on our Promises – Other Manifesto Tax Commitments
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Stamp Duty Land Tax (SDLT): Increase the Higher Rate of Additional Dwelling (HRAD) of SDLT by 2ppts from 3% to 5% from 31 October 2024
measures.group: Delivering on our Promises – Other Manifesto Tax Commitments
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Employer National Insurance contributions: Increase rate by 1.2ppts to 15%, cut the Secondary Threshold to £5,000 until 5 April 2028 and uprate with CPI thereafter, increase Employment Allowance to £10,500, remove the £100,000 Employment Allowance eligibility threshold
measures.group: Repairing the Public Finances – Raising Revenue Fairly
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Capital Gains Tax: Increase the main rates of CGT to 18% and 24% from 30 October 2024, and the Business Asset Disposal Relief (BADR) and Investors’ Relief (IR) rate to 14% from 6 April 2025 and to 18% from 6 April 2026
measures.group: Repairing the Public Finances – Raising Revenue Fairly
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Inheritance Tax: Include unused pension funds and death benefits payable from a pension in the value of estates from 6 April 2027
measures.group: Repairing the Public Finances – Raising Revenue Fairly
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Inheritance Tax: Reform agricultural property relief and business property relief from 6 April 2026 by maintaining 100% relief for the first £1m of combined assets and 50% relief thereafter, and 50% relief for “not listed” shares on the markets of a recognised stock exchange
measures.group: Repairing the Public Finances – Raising Revenue Fairly
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Inheritance Tax: Maintain thresholds at current levels for a further two years until 5 April 2030
measures.group: Repairing the Public Finances – Raising Revenue Fairly
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Savings: Maintain subscription limits at current levels for Adult ISAs, Junior ISAs and Child Trust Funds from 6 April 2025 to 5 April 2030
measures.group: Repairing the Public Finances – Raising Revenue Fairly
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Company Car Tax: Set appropriate percentages for electric vehicles, hybrids and internal combustion engine vehicles for 2028-29 and 2029-30
measures.group: Repairing the Public Finances – Duties & Levies
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Vehicle Excise Duty: from 1 April 2025, freeze the lowest First Year Rate (FYR) paid by zero emission cars until 2029-30, increase FYRs for all other emission bands including hybrids and Internal Combustion Engine vehicles in 2025-26
measures.group: Repairing the Public Finances – Duties & Levies
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Air Passenger Duty: Adjustment to increase all rates from 2026-27 with a further 50% increase for larger private jets, and rates set to nearest penny from 2027-28
measures.group: Repairing the Public Finances – Duties & Levies
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Vaping Products Duty: Introduce a flat rate duty at £2.20/10ml from 1 October 2026
measures.group: Repairing the Public Finances – Duties & Levies
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Tobacco Duty: Introduce a tobacco duty escalator of RPI +2% for the Parliament; increase duty on hand rolling tobacco a further 10% (RPI+12%) for 2024-25 from 30 October 2024; and a separate one-off duty increase to maintain financial incentive to choose vaping over smoking from 1 October 2026
measures.group: Repairing the Public Finances – Duties & Levies
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Soft Drinks Industry Levy: Uprate by CPI since introduction in 2018 evenly across the forecast period and uprate annually by CPI from 1 April 2025
measures.group: Repairing the Public Finances – Duties & Levies
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Winter Fuel Payments: Target payments at recipients of Pension Credit and certain other means-tested benefits from winter 2024-25
measures.group: Repairing the Public Finances – Targeting Support and Reducing Fraud and Error in the Welfare System
measures.head: spend

measures.name: Pensions: Enhance Pension Credit take-up for new claims to Housing Benefit from April 2025
measures.group: Repairing the Public Finances – Targeting Support and Reducing Fraud and Error in the Welfare System
measures.head: spend

measures.name: Universal Credit: Accelerate migration of Employment and Support Allowance claimants onto Universal Credit from September 2024
measures.group: Repairing the Public Finances – Targeting Support and Reducing Fraud and Error in the Welfare System
measures.head: spend

measures.name: Universal Credit: Amending Severe Disability Premium transitional protection regulations
measures.group: Repairing the Public Finances – Targeting Support and Reducing Fraud and Error in the Welfare System
measures.head: spend

measures.name: Investment in additional 3,000 fraud and error staff in DWP from April 2025
measures.group: Repairing the Public Finances – Targeting Support and Reducing Fraud and Error in the Welfare System
measures.head: spend

measures.name: New investment to verify Universal Credit claimant changes to tackle fraud and error from April 2025
measures.group: Repairing the Public Finances – Targeting Support and Reducing Fraud and Error in the Welfare System
measures.head: spend

measures.name: Extending Targeted Case Review of Universal Credit claims from April 2028
measures.group: Repairing the Public Finances – Targeting Support and Reducing Fraud and Error in the Welfare System
measures.head: spend

measures.name: Investment in additional 180 welfare counter-fraud staff in HMRC to tackle fraud and error in Child Benefit and Tax-Free Childcare from April 2025
measures.group: Repairing the Public Finances – Targeting Support and Reducing Fraud and Error in the Welfare System
measures.head: spend

measures.name: Increase DWP fraud and error debt recovery powers – resource cost for measures which yield a PSNCR saving of £260m in 2029-30
measures.group: Repairing the Public Finances – Targeting Support and Reducing Fraud and Error in the Welfare System
measures.head: spend

measures.name: Business Rates: 40% relief for Retail, Hospitality and Leisure (RHL) sectors for 2025-26 from 1 April 2025, up to a £110,000 cash cap per business
measures.group: Supporting Business, Families, and Local Communities
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Business Rates: Freeze the small business multiplier for 2025-26
measures.group: Supporting Business, Families, and Local Communities
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Fuel duty: One year extension to the 5p cut in rates and no RPI increase in 2025-26
measures.group: Supporting Business, Families, and Local Communities
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Capital allowances: extend 100% first-year allowances for zero-emission cars and electric vehicle charge-points to 31 March 2026 for Corporation Tax and 5 April 2026 for Income Tax
measures.group: Supporting Business, Families, and Local Communities
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Alternative Finance: Changes to tax rules on alternative finance arrangements from 30 October 2024
measures.group: Supporting Business, Families, and Local Communities
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Alcohol Duty: Increase Draught Relief to reduce duty on an average ABV pint by 1p from 1 February 2025
measures.group: Supporting Business, Families, and Local Communities
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Carer’s Allowance: Increasing the earnings limit to the equivalent of 16 hours at the National Living Wage from April 2025
measures.group: Supporting Business, Families, and Local Communities
measures.head: spend

measures.name: Help to Save: Extend the current scheme with expanded eligibility to include all working UC claimants earning £1 or more, from 6 April 2025 to 5 April 2027
measures.group: Supporting Business, Families, and Local Communities
measures.head: spend

measures.name: Mineworkers Pension Scheme: Transfer of the Mineworkers Pension Scheme Investment Reserve to the scheme Trustees
measures.group: Supporting Business, Families, and Local Communities
measures.head: spend

measures.name: Veterans: Extend employer NICs relief for hiring veterans for one year from 6 April 2025
measures.group: Supporting Business, Families, and Local Communities
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Right to Buy: Reduce discounts and allow local authorities to retain full receipts from 21 November 2024
measures.group: Supporting Business, Families, and Local Communities
measures.head: spend

measures.name: Public Works Loan Board: Extend discounted Public Works Loan Board rate for local authorities borrowing for social housing from 30 June 2025 to 31 March 2026
measures.group: Supporting Business, Families, and Local Communities
measures.head: spend

measures.name: Borrowing powers: Granting borrowing powers to newly established Mayoral Combined Authorities
measures.group: Supporting Business, Families, and Local Communities
measures.head: spend

measures.name: Business Rates retention: Extend Greater London Authority enhanced business rates retention arrangements at 67% for 2025-26 and extend 100% local retention in Cornwall, Liverpool City Region and the West of England Combined Authority area
measures.group: Supporting Business, Families, and Local Communities
measures.head: spend

measures.name: Tariff Changes since Spring Budget 2024
measures.group: Tariffs & Technical Tax Changes
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Special Education Needs and Disabilities: Reduction in Local Authority SEND deficits as a result of additional DEL funding
measures.group: Tariffs & Technical Tax Changes
measures.head: spend

measures.name: Universal Credit: Extend the £2,500 surplus earnings threshold for one year from April 2025
measures.group: Tariffs & Technical Tax Changes
measures.head: spend

measures.name: Van Benefit Charge: Uprate by CPI from 6 April 2025
measures.group: Tariffs & Technical Tax Changes
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Climate Change Levy (CCL): Amendments to the Climate Change Agreement scheme from 1 January 2026, meaning new entrants will be able to claim relief on their CCL bill before completing a target period
measures.group: Tariffs & Technical Tax Changes
measures.head: tax

measures.name: The Starting Rate for Savings (SRS): Maintain the SRS at £5,000 for 2025-26 from 6 April 2025
measures.group: Tariffs & Technical Tax Changes
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Private Intermittent Securities and Capital Exchange System (PISCES): Exempt transfers of shares made on a PISCES platform from Stamp Taxes on Shares
measures.group: Tariffs & Technical Tax Changes
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM): Confirming sectoral scope of the UK CBAM from 1 January 2027 to be aluminium, cement, fertiliser, hydrogen, and iron and steel.
measures.group: Tariffs & Technical Tax Changes
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Carbon Price Support (CPS): Maintain the freeze of CPS rates at the equivalent of £18 per tonne of CO2 from 1 April 2026
measures.group: Tariffs & Technical Tax Changes
measures.head: tax

measures.name: Lifelong Learning Entitlement: Implementation to amended timetable
measures.group: Tariffs & Technical Tax Changes
measures.head: spend

footnotes.4: Costing reflects assumed increase in Pension Credit take-up.
footnotes.5: Totals may not sum due to rounding.
footnotes.6: The totals for tax and spending reflect both the tax and spend impacts of each measure. Totals may not sum by head classification.
